raw.one_liner: Narma provides an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to observe, understand, and automate work processes using AI agents.
raw.thesis: Narma is an innovative venture aiming to provide AI-first companies with a comprehensive solution for deploying AI automation at scale. The core innovation lies in its "Enterprise Agentic Brain" which observes work patterns, detects employee intent and business value of tasks, and identifies "drift" from intended workflows. This intelligence then feeds into an "Agent Factory" that automates the generation, deployment, and monitoring of AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. Importantly, Narma leverages existing foundation models, focusing its proprietary technology on understanding and optimizing the "Work Graph" within an organization. This allows it to identify precise points where AI intervention can provide assistance and drive continuous improvement. Narma aims to solve the critical problems faced by enterprises in accurately measuring AI savings, ensuring reliable ROI, and managing the constant evolution of AI systems and human workflows. The founder has not specified their goal (lifestyle, growth, or moonshot) or current stage, but the description suggests an advanced concept or early development phase. Narma is positioned to complement existing AI technologies by providing an overarching intelligence layer that orchestrates and optimizes AI automation within an enterprise setting, rather than replacing fundamental AI models.

market_data.trigger_now: Struggles with lack of telemetry for AI savings, unreliable ROI, and constant drift in systems and human resources.

raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's core innovation is its "Enterprise Agentic Brain" that leverages existing foundation models to understand an organization's "Work Graph" and automatically deploy AI agents where they can have the highest impact, addressing issues like unreliable ROI measurement and workflow drift.
raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. It has three layers: Observe (lightweight desktop sensors capture work patterns), Intelligence Layer (detects employee intent, business value, and "drift"), and Execution Layer (Agent Factory automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents). The system uses existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to identify AI automation opportunities.
